sources.title: Mustafa Suleyman - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Mustafa Suleyman CBE (born in August 1984 [2]) is a British artificial intelligence (AI) entrepreneur. He is the CEO of Microsoft AI, and the co-founder and former head of applied AI at DeepMind, an AI company which was acquired by Google. [3][4] After leaving DeepMind, he co-founded Inflection AI, a machine learning and generative AI company, in 2022. [5][6]
